description:
FILED s507b (Opus, 2026-10-04) from member 1's (#2680) breaking-case probes; PRE-EXISTING on main 08de9e4f, NOT changed by #2680.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):
  sub la { my ($x) = @_ }
  my @la = (la(5), 1);  my $las = la(5, 6);
  print scalar(@la), " $las\n";
  perl: "2 2"   (list context: the list assignment's value is ($x) = (5), one element; scalar: the RHS COUNT, 2)
  PCL : "2 "    (list: ONE undef element -- the value is NIL, not $x; scalar: empty)

CAUSE (read, not measured): Parser2::_lower_sub_inner's `my (PARAMS) = @_` fast paths CONSUME the body's leading
unpack statement and lower the REST; when the rest is empty there is no tail form, so the body value is NIL (the
shift-run twin has $tail_param for exactly this; the list-unpack spelling has none).  #2680 (s507b) keeps that path
on its old NIL deliberately (_lower_body_regime's $keep_nil) because the empty-list value would be wrong too.
FIX DIRECTION: when the unpack IS the whole body, the tail is the list assignment's value -- in list context the
params (as `$tail_param` does for one), in scalar context the @_ count.  Probe `sub f { my ($a, $b) = @_ }` in list
/ scalar / void, a signature-normalized sub (must stay the EMPTY list, #752), and `sub f { my ($x) = @_; }` with a
trailing `;`.  Probe file: worktree agent-abf54c6d69793c324 scratch/s507b/p/m1d.pl row `la`.


=== DONE (s507c, built s508, shipped s509) ===
A body that is ONLY `my (LIST) = @_` now takes the general sub lowering (Parser2 _lower_sub_inner), where the unpack is an ordinary last statement: list context ($x...), scalar context the @_ count.  Signature-normalized subs keep the empty list (#752); a shift run keeps $tail_param.  One perl-probed table "value of a sub's last statement" (scratch/s507c/p2b/lastval.pl, 40 rows: list/scalar assignment, decl, local, bare block, {;}, do{}, if-false, for, while, unless/else, map {;}) -- only la1-la3 (this task), bb2 (#2701) and lo1/lo2 (scalar `local` tail, FILED #2742) differed.  Guard Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t last row (fails on main).
subject: SILENT WRONG (PRE-EXISTING): a sub whose WHOLE body is `my ($x) = @_` returns undef in list context and nothing in scalar context; perl returns ($x) / the argument count
